0022600222.text: The Bucks (1-10) host the Lakers (10-2), who lead the Pacific and sit first in the West, while Milwaukee is 15th in the East and 5th in the Central, 6.5 games back, on a seven-game losing streak. Tyler Herro is out with a knee bruise after averaging 21.4 points and 30.7 minutes per game this season, and Los Angeles has Quentin Grimes listed as day-to-day with a finger injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Milwaukee winning the most recent meeting 105-101 in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026.
